LanguageData.FH_FleshHive.label: flesh hive
LanguageData.FH_FleshHive.description: The foundation of a flesh hive. It can gestate fleshbeasts within the nest and spreads flesh carpet outward to expand the hive. Because of the artificially implanted dark archite shards, it can no longer expand without limit or draw nutrients from the surroundings on its own. It must instead rely on deliberate feeding, a far safer way to sustain the hive.
LanguageData.FH_FleshTree.label: flesh tree
LanguageData.FH_FleshTree.description: A towering tree made entirely of flesh. Infect a harbinger tree with twisted meat to transform it into a flesh tree. It feeds on nearby corpses, raw meat, and heads. Unlike a harbinger tree, the flesh tree is connected to the flesh hive: the nutrition it absorbs supports the whole hive instead of reproducing itself.
LanguageData.FH_FleshBush.label: fleshberry bush
LanguageData.FH_FleshBush.description: A strange fleshy mass with a few thorns, like a twisted copy of some ordinary shrub. It grows edible red fleshberries and yields a large amount of twisted meat when harvested.
LanguageData.FH_ChoppedStump_FleshTree.label: chopped flesh tree stump
LanguageData.FH_ChoppedStump_FleshTree.description: A stump left behind after a flesh tree has been felled.
LanguageData.FH_SmashedStump_FleshTree.label: smashed flesh tree stump
LanguageData.FH_SmashedStump_FleshTree.description: The pulped remains of a destroyed flesh tree.
LanguageData.FH_FleshParasiteVat.label: flesh parasite vat
LanguageData.FH_FleshParasiteVat.description: A flesh device made from sharp bone-spike tentacles and clotted flesh. It gradually devours fleshbeast cells and implants them into a host, allowing the fleshbeast to survive independently inside the host's body. The parasite strengthens its host and can actively attack the host's enemies, but its nutrition must be supplied by the host, causing the host to become hungry more easily.
LanguageData.FH_FleshTurret.label: bone spitter
LanguageData.FH_FleshTurret.description: A small, short-ranged defensive fleshmass organ. After prolonged use, it needs a large amount of nutrition to grow replacement bone spikes.
LanguageData.FH_FleshmassSpitter.label: fleshmass spitter
LanguageData.FH_FleshmassSpitter.description: A defensive fleshmass organ that can spit acid long distances. The acid is a natural byproduct of toxins filtered from the surrounding biomass.
LanguageData.FH_FleshSpreader.label: flesh burster
LanguageData.FH_FleshSpreader.description: A flesh organ made from clusters of high-pressure vesicles and a fragile outer wall. It explodes when triggered by a living creature or hit by bullets, spreading flesh plates across the nearby ground. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense it when calm.
LanguageData.FH_FleshDigester.label: guard tentacle nexus
LanguageData.FH_FleshDigester.description: A flesh neural organ responsible for guarding the hive. It activates nearby flesh to lash at intruders, hindering their movement and inflicting damage. It can also consume nearby corpses and raw meat to replenish hive nutrition.
LanguageData.FH_NerveBundle.label: hive nerve bundle
LanguageData.FH_NerveBundle.description: A node in the fleshmass nervous system. It can expand hive scale and provide an independent hive control beacon. It spreads flesh carpet outward, expanding the hive. When fleshbeasts have low control, they need to return to the node to recover control, or they may enter a berserk state.
LanguageData.FH_NerveCenter.label: hive nerve center
LanguageData.FH_NerveCenter.description: The core node of the fleshmass nervous system. It can greatly expand hive scale and provide an independent hive control beacon. It spreads flesh carpet outward, expanding the hive. When fleshbeasts have low control, they need to return to the node to recover control, or they may enter a berserk state. A hive nerve center makes fleshbeasts easier to control.
LanguageData.FH_DormantFissionmeld.label: weakened fissionmeld
LanguageData.FH_DormantFissionmeld.description: A structure produced by a fissionmeld in its weakened state to prevent its own complete death.
